description.value: Taylight Kitchen is a community-driven craft beer and kitchen concept in downtown Vancouver where guests can vote on dishes to shape an ever-evolving menu. The restaurant brews its own lineup of craft beers — from a Czech Pilsner to a New England IPA — and pairs them with farm-to-table small plates and mains drawing on Pacific Rim flavours. With indoor seating and a full menu of food and drink, it's a solid stop for a sit-down meal after a city ride.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is an active craft beer and kitchen restaurant in downtown Vancouver, with phone 604-564-1990 and email info@taylightkitchen.com matching OSM. The menu pages use V/GF/GFO labels throughout, confirming vegetarian and gluten-free options per OSM's diet tags; an 'Order Now' button on the homepage indicates takeout is available. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or charging anywhere on the site.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the business as 'Taylight' but the website consistently uses 'Taylight Kitchen' as the full business name.

Website footer contains an apparent template placeholder: 'Laurent Fine dining, 107 Duncan Avenue, New York 914-309-7030' — this is a Snappy website builder artifact and does not represent the actual business address, but it may confuse automated scrapers.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate, active full-service restaurant in downtown Vancouver with confirmed online presence, vegetarian and GF options, and takeout availability — useful to a touring cyclist seeking a meal stop.
